meta.name: SoFlo Bathroom Remodel — Email Database
meta.description: Master list of bad (spam/blocklist) and good (legit lead/customer/allowlist) emails. Used for spam filtering, email validation, lead-quality tracking, and as labeled training data.

fields.email: Full email address, lowercased (e.g. "jane@example.com"). Optional if 'domain' is set for a whole-domain rule.
fields.domain: Domain only, lowercased (e.g. "example.com"). Use for blocking/allowing an entire domain.
fields.category: Free-form bucket. Bad: spam | phishing | disposable | bot | competitor. Good: lead | customer | partner | vendor.
fields.reason: Short human note on why it's on this list.

bad.reason: EXAMPLE ENTRY — disposable/throwaway domain. Replace with real data.

good.reason: EXAMPLE ENTRY — confirmed past customer. Replace with real data.
